title: Arrival at the Collegium
introNarration: A sturdy hedgehog in a worn porter's coat steps out from the lanterns, whistle on a leather cord, quills neat as a roll-call. Porter Bramble names the first words: look, then help.
reminderNarration: Porter Bramble stays at your side until Arrival is finished.

objectives.label: Look around Lantern Court. Type look to see Lantern Court.
Say hello so Porter knows you arrived.
Take the Small Copper Key from Porter. Type take key.
Type north to reach the Great Hall.
